svg.title: Walking forward response across saved checkpoints

cc:Work.dc:title: Walking forward response across saved checkpoints
cc:Work.dc:description: Four simulator and native PPO combinations, each comparing original and delayed smoothing schedules. Same-seed perturbation-enabled evaluation; no full acceptance passes.
